page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, indicating a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio with no hyperthreading. It features 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include any bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation offers predictable compute performance without resource contention, though the lack of local storage and GPU accelerators limits its use to non-accelerated workloads. The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance suitable for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded enterprise applications, web serving, and database hosting that require consistent CPU performance.
